Q05. Focus on the very latest information: What is the sentiment/tone including the very latest information on US interest rates?
Sentiment: -20 (Mildly dovish — US Treasury yields retreating from multi-year highs suggests some relief from hawkish pressure; however no explicit Fed pivot signal. BOJ hike speculation dominates rate narrative, not the Fed. Labor data (ADP miss) marginally supports a softer Fed path.)
